newsitem.title: UK: Bass shares slide in nervy trading.
newsitem.headline: Bass shares slide in nervy trading.

text.p: Shares in Bass Plc dropped in thin, nervy trading on Friday with dealers at a loss to explain the movements in the stock.
Bass lost 22-1/2p to 755p - a near three percent fall - and has retreated 95p from its record high of 850p set on August 29.

Some dealers said there were worries about talk of a line of stock in the market and continuing jitters ahead of further news on its Carlsberg Tetley purchase. "I think that's rubbish. What you're seeing today is lack of business and big moves because market-makers can get away with it," said a senior trader.
"There's supposed to be five million shares around but if you ask anyone they'll say we've heard but we haven't seen it," he added.
